title_en: Character Riddles (3/20): Both the Sun and the Moon
note_en: The brother wonders why one character 又表示“亮”，又表示“明天”，又表示“懂” "means 'bright,' and 'tomorrow,' and 'understand.'" Repeating 又 before each item (又…又…) links two or more qualities or actions that hold at the same time, much like English "both ... and ..." or "at once ... and ...". The teacher uses it too: 又明又亮 "bright and shining."
